learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore beautiful geometric patterns, fractions, and symmetry by looking at the amazing designs in a colorful quilt!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A quilt is made by stitching many small shapes together. We can find triangles, squares, and hexagons hiding in the beautiful patchwork designs!
If a square quilt has 4 equal patches and 1 is red, we can say 1/4 of the quilt is red. Fractions help us describe the colors perfectly.
Grandmother makes sure the left side of the quilt matches the right side exactly. This mirror-like matching is called beautiful symmetry!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Paper Quilt Maker
fun_activity.instructions: Cut out some colorful paper squares and triangles. Glue them on a blank page to create your very own beautiful, symmetrical quilt pattern!

quick_recap: ⭐ Quilts are full of geometric shapes like squares and triangles.
⭐ We use fractions to tell how much of the quilt is a certain color.
⭐ Symmetrical designs make the quilt look perfectly balanced and beautiful!
